create.name: Ruthie Lindsey
create.bio:
Ruthie Lindsey is a somatic coach, speaker and writer based in Nashville, Tennessee. Her work centres on women who have already spent years on inner growth and now want that understanding to settle into the body and into everyday choices. Her own route there was long: a serious accident in her teens was followed by a decade of hard recovery and searching, and she came out of it convinced that insight on its own rarely sets anyone free. She tells that story in her memoir There I Am, published by Simon & Schuster in 2020.

In her teaching she draws on shadow work, breathwork, meditation, ecstatic dance, journaling and simple ritual, and she brings as much warmth and humour to it as depth. She coaches women one to one through a six-month process she calls Threshold, runs The River Within, a twelve-week online group that ends with an in-person weekend in Nashville, and hosts Love's Invitation, a Substack community with monthly live gatherings on spirituality, ritual and connection. She speaks at events such as CreativeMornings and leads weekend retreats at Kripalu on welcoming back the parts of ourselves we once learned to hide.

videos.title: Ruthie Lindsey: Watching beauty spill out of brokenness

courses.title: Reclamation: The Holy Work of Welcoming Home the Parts of You That You Cut Off to Belong
courses.description: A weekend retreat at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, about the feelings and traits many of us pushed away to fit in, such as anger, sensitivity or wildness. Ruthie guides the group through shadow work, meditation, breathwork, ecstatic dance, play and journaling, with plenty of laughter along the way.

courses.title: Threshold: 1:1 Somatic Coaching
courses.description: Six months of private coaching for women who understand their patterns well but still feel stuck. It runs as three sessions a month with voice-message contact between sessions, and moves from feeling and meeting hidden parts of yourself towards small, real steps in daily life. It begins with a discovery call.

courses.title: The River Within
courses.description: A twelve-week group programme of weekly live online workshops, co-led with writer Ally, followed by a two-day in-person intensive in Nashville. The weekend includes somatic practice, writing, intuitive dance and breathwork, and an accountability group carries the work between sessions. New rounds open from a waitlist.

courses.title: Love's Invitation Membership
courses.description: Ruthie's Substack community, with free weekly essays and a paid tier. Paid members join a monthly live gathering, which might be a Q&A with Ruthie or a guest, a somatic practice, a dance night or a group ritual.
courses.price: $6 USD a month or $60 USD a year

free_resources.title: Loving All Your Parts Meditation
free_resources.description: A guided meditation on meeting every part of yourself with kindness. It is sent free when you join Ruthie's weekly newsletter.

sprint.tier_evidence: Instagram @ruthielindsey 115K followers (og:description, 1 Nov 2026); Facebook ruthielindseyspeaker 6,956 followers (og:description, 1 Nov 2026); no YouTube channel of her own found; Substack 'thousands of subscribers' not counted → ~122,000 total → luminary
flags: Tier total (~122K) falls in the 80k–150k borderline band; almost all of it is Instagram.
The email is her assistant's Gmail address (ruthielassistant@gmail.com), published on The River Within page; her contact page itself only offers a discovery-call booking.

Her public story and memoir centre on years of severe pain after a teenage accident, and her site calls her a 'trauma-informed' somatic coach. Her current offers are framed around integration and self-acceptance rather than conditions, so I kept her, but the bio only mentions the accident and recovery in general terms.
Most YouTube interviews with her are titled around pain or healing and were left out. Only two talks with neutral titles are listed, both on other channels (CreativeMornings, Plywood People).
The River Within is co-led with someone named only as 'Ally' on the page; the description uses that name.
left_out: There I Am: The Journey from Hopelessness to Healing (ASIN 1982107928): the title and Amazon blurb are framed around chronic pain and healing (health-claim rule).
Wild Harmony Retreat (Telluride, 31 Jul–2 Aug): dated and past, and billed as an equine therapy retreat.
Shadow Work as a Practice of Self-Love (online, 11 Aug, $39): dated and past.

YouTube interviews titled around chronic pain, healing, trauma, recovery or quarantine (e.g. 'Healing Chronic Pain, Self-Love & Awakening', 'Joy Through Pain', 'Hard-Wired For Belonging' on a recovery podcast, 'Thriving in Quarantine').
The Sit-Down (CBS Local News) and the CBS New York memoir interview: short news interviews, not teaching.
